title: A-C pair at rest, separation 2.5 to 3.5: repulsion with separation-dependent coefficients K_AC(r) = -8.8 to -9.1 and K_CA(r) = -20.8 to -21.8 (P = 2.5)

claims.statement: Two particles, one species A and one species C, at rest, initial separation 2.5 to 3.5, duration at most 2: each particle is pushed away from the other with magnitude K(r)/r^2.5 (P = 2.5 fixed, r the current separation), where K_AC(r) acts on the A particle and K_CA(r) on the C particle. Both K are piecewise-linear in r with nodes at r = 2.5, 3.0, 3.5: K_AC = -8.820, -9.064, -9.096 and K_CA = -20.831, -21.319, -21.757. Fitted to ten lab-vernier runs (2026-11-24/r3 001-010; separations 2.5, 3.0, 3.5; durations 1 and 2). Fit residual is at tracker noise (0.050 per coordinate). The model does not claim A-A or C-C pairs.
